1945, August 28.
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.P.K. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N. Y.
August 28, 1945
Mrs. Mary Kenny 2140 Concord Ave. Detroit Mich'n.
Dear Mrs. Kenny: God bless you and yours. I came down from Retreat in Garrison a few days ago to find quite a stack of letters a- waiting opening. I just came to yours of the 23nd and sure do sympathize with you and your family. However, we've had so many decidedly worse reports than about your Pat, that turned out most remarkable after several months of suspence and anxiety, that I shall still hope for a good word about Son Patrick F.
At all events I have just enrolled him in the Seraphic Masses as requested and we shall not be surprised at any favorable report to come. We'll pray and hope - trusting in God for the best. After all if we look at things in light of faith, the worst, as the world considers things, is only cur Victory - according to our dear Lord's own words: "Greater love than this no man hath that a man give his life for his friends". This I think ought to
buoy us up as it is needed in millions of sad bereavements these days ... God bless you again and love to all the family and friends Sincerely in the Sacred Heart, Fr. Solanus. O.F.K.C.
Original in possession of: Mrs. Martha Stavale 5034 Grayton Detroit, KI. 48224
